name: fix-baijiahao-schedule-time

artifacts.proposal: Fix the random-hour selection bug in BaiJiaHaoVideo.set_schedule_time (uploader/baijiahao_uploader/main.py). The hour VALUE (e.g. 14 for 2pm) was used as an INDEX into the platform's hour dropdown, picking a random available hour instead of the requested one. Originally annotated as FIXME(known-bug) in the parent change `cli-uploader-architecture-consistency` per its design.md D4; this change is the explicit follow-up ticket D4 promised.

parentTaskReference: Task 4.4 (add FIXME annotation — to be removed by this change once implemented)
